1.title: White, green, and blue, hangings
1.subtitle: Ahasuerus makes a feast in the court of the garden of the king’s palace at Shushan.

1.title: The queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment
1.subtitle: The chamberlains return without her, and the king’s wise men take counsel.

2.title: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther
2.subtitle: Mordecai and his young cousin, before the maidens are gathered to Shushan.

2.title: Set the royal crown upon her head
2.subtitle: The king loved Esther above all the women.

2.title: The thing was known to Mordecai
2.subtitle: Two chamberlains plot against the king at the gate; it is written in the book of the chronicles.

3.title: Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence
3.subtitle: All the king’s servants in the gate bow before Haman.

3.title: The king took his ring from his hand
3.subtitle: Lots are cast before Haman, and the decree goes out to all the provinces.

4.title: Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
4.subtitle: Mordecai in sackcloth at the king’s gate; Esther’s answer: if I perish, I perish.

5.title: The king held out to Esther the golden sceptre
5.subtitle: She stands in the inner court, and obtains favour in his sight.

5.title: Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high
5.subtitle: Haman, full of indignation against Mordecai, at home with Zeresh his wife.

6.title: On that night could not the king sleep
6.subtitle: The book of records of the chronicles is read before the king.

6.title: Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour
6.subtitle: Haman leads Mordecai on horseback through the street of the city.

7.title: The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman
7.subtitle: Esther pleads for her life and her people at the banquet of wine.

8.title: Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel
8.subtitle: Blue and white, with a great crown of gold; the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

9.title: The Jews had rule over them that hated them
9.subtitle: They gather in their cities on the thirteenth day of Adar, and on the fourteenth rest.

9.title: Wherefore they called these days Purim
9.subtitle: Days of feasting and joy, of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

10.title: Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus
10.subtitle: Seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
